Q2: How can I create an account?
Q3: How do I add a book to my exchange list?
Q4: How do I search for books available for exchange?
Q5: How do I start the book exchange process?
Q6: Is the exchange done only within the app?
Q7: Are there any fees for using the app?
Q8: How can I ensure the safety of the exchange?
Q9: What should I do if I encounter an issue with another user?
Q11: Can I edit the details of a book I added?
Q12: How can I contact the technical support team?
Ans1: ReBook is an app designed to facilitate book exchanges between users. You can list books you want to exchange, lend, sell, or donate, and search for books that match your interests.
Ans2: You can easily create an account using your email and password, or sign up with your Google account.
Ans3:
1. Open the app and click on the 'Add Book' button.
2. Add a cover image of the book.
3. Enter the book details (title, author, condition, short description).
4. Click 'Save', and the book will be displayed in your list.
Ans4: Use the search bar on the home page to look for a specific book or author, or browse the public library to explore books by category.
Ans5:
1. When you find a book that suits you, click on it to view its details.
2. Choose the 'Request Book' option and send a message to the book owner.
3. A notification will be sent to the book owner, and you can agree on the exchange terms via messages.
Ans6: Yes, you can initiate the exchange process within the app, but shipping or personal delivery details depend on the agreement between you and the other user.
Ans7: The app is free for basic use. There may be nominal fees if you choose additional services like delivery or premium subscriptions.
Ans8: A rating and review feature will be added to verify user reliability. Only share your personal information when necessary, and adhere to the exchange terms agreed upon within the app.
Ans9: If you encounter any issue, you can report the user through their profile or contact the technical support team via More > Technical Support.
Ans10: Yes, you can delete your account at any time through More > Account Management, then click 'Delete Account'. All your data will be deleted after confirming the process.
Ans11: Yes, you can edit any added book by going to 'My Books', selecting the book, and then clicking the 'Edit' icon.
Ans12: You can contact us via email: booklink.app@gmail.com, or use the chat feature within the app in the 'Technical Support' section.
